versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text:
(a) Category N. A placard shall be provided in front of ana in clear view of the pilot stating: “No acrobatic maneuvers including spins approved.”
(b) Category U. A placard shall be provided in clear view of the pilot stating: “Acrobatic maneuvers are limited to the following: __..-.---_--------.-- (ist approved maneuvers) .” (ec) Category A. A placard shall be provided in clear view of the pilot which lists all approved acrobatic maneuvers and the recommended entry air speed for each. If inverted flight maneuvers are not approved, the placard shall bear a notation to this effect.
